title: WB-F1 calibration build inputs
description: calibration/build.json (agent PR, reviewed; model ids never live in engine code), read by engine/calib-build.ts parseBuildConfig for c1-build. Rewrites come from primary_model and contrast_models, cliche-degraded copies from degrade_model; every model must map to a non-judge family through families.json prefixes (parseBuildConfig checks that, and that the models are distinct, which the schema subset cannot express). passage_files are world/current-relative 8.1 files (01-06, 08); passages are blank-line blocks of passage_chars [min, max] characters after Markdown stripping, at most max_passages_per_file per file; a rewrite may differ from its target length by length_tolerance_pct percent.
